ipis:Magwa:-1.247319,26.420705.name: Magwa
ipis:Magwa:-1.247319,26.420705.desc: Field-visited by IPIS. Mineral: Diamant. Reported workers: 36. IPIS has mapped these sites through repeat field visits, recording child labour, armed-group interference, worker numbers and minerals per site. This is a site in a sector where forced or child labour is documented to concentrate. It is not evidence that this particular site uses it.

kilns:Brick kiln:21.4283,69.7796.name: Brick kiln
kilns:Brick kiln:21.4283,69.7796.desc: The position is the tile’s own reference point — the dataset records kilns as annotated boxes inside a satellite tile rather than as individual coordinates, so this locates them to within about a kilometre, not to a chimney. Detected from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and hand-validated, from SentinelKilnDB — 62,671 kilns across the Indo-Gangetic Plain covering India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan. Brick kilns are the most consistently documented bonded-labour sector in South Asia: the mechanism is the peshgi advance, worked off across a whole family at a rate that never clears. This is a site in a sector where forced or child labour is documented to concentrate. It is not evidence that this particular site uses it.
